correctness.rationale: Exact least-squares solves and Sylvester principal-minor test yield the 3x3 rank collapse and positive 8/105 residual gap. A one-entry 2x2 SPD enrichment is triangular with positive diagonal, so dimension three is minimal. The exact epsilon determinant formula, rank-two limit and singular-value continuity imply Theta(1/epsilon) deterioration. Exact rational verification and an independent symbolic recomputation corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Loss of invertibility of a preconditioner is a structural barrier to stable linear-system reformulation. The exact three-dimensional minimal obstruction and the perturbation showing unbounded condition-number deterioration despite strictly improving Frobenius objective explain precisely why local residual improvement alone is not a spectral safeguard. The value is a motivated boundary example, not algorithmic frequency or finite-precision performance.
